2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Use bin/docker instead of docker compose
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: Do not add or change commands that invoke `docker compose` directly; use `bin/docker` as the wrapper.
HOW: In added lines, flag any shell command, script, README, or CI snippet containing `docker compose` / `docker-compose` rather than `bin/docker`.

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Use data-test-id, not data-testid
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: New or changed React markup must use `data-test-id` for test selectors, not the React default `data-testid`.
HOW: In added JSX/TSX lines, flag any attribute named `data-testid`.

detector.reason: Flags any added JSX/TSX line containing the forbidden `data-testid` attribute.

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Do not hardcode user-facing strings
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: User-facing copy must not be written as a literal in code; it should come from `t()` and locale files.
HOW: In added app/client code, flag visible text literals passed directly to UI props or rendered in markup instead of a translation call.

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Do not read encrypted credentials as plaintext
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: Never inspect encrypted credential files by printing or catting their contents.
HOW: In added shell commands or scripts, flag `cat *.enc.yml` or equivalent direct plaintext dumping of an `.enc.yml` file.

detector.reason: Directly matches added shell lines that cat an encrypted credentials file ending in .enc.yml.

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Prefer real services over mocks when available
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: In specs, do not mock a service that already exists as a docker-backed real service in the test environment.
HOW: In added spec lines, flag stubbing/mocking of Redis, Typesense, or Postgres interactions when the test could use the real container instead.

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Keep temporary code tagged for later removal
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: Temporary code awaiting cleanup must include the required greppable TODO tag format.
HOW: In added comments, flag placeholders that do not match `TODO: <EPIC-TAG> remove after <condition>` exactly enough to be grep-friendly.

examples.snippet: # TODO: AUTH-123 remove after rollout completes

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Update CODEBASE_MAP.md when features change
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: Any feature addition, edit, or removal must be reflected in `CODEBASE_MAP.md` in the same PR.
HOW: In added feature code or deletions, flag changes that introduce/remove a feature without a corresponding `CODEBASE_MAP.md` update.

examples.snippet:
# feature code changed
class Billing::InvoiceService; end

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Update CLAUDE.md after correcting a convention
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: When a convention or gotcha is corrected by the user, the fix must be captured in the closest `CLAUDE.md`.
HOW: In added documentation changes after such a correction, flag the absence of a matching `CLAUDE.md` update.

examples.snippet: # CLAUDE.md updated with the corrected convention

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Use the repo PR template and fill all sections
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: New pull requests must be created from `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` and every section must be completed, including Jira ticket, PR purpose, optional Sentry fix line, and author checklist.
HOW: In added PR body text or automation snippets, flag PR creation that omits the template or leaves required sections blank.

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Prefix resolvable review comments with Blocker
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: Review comments that must be resolved must start with `Blocker:`.
HOW: In added review-comment text, flag required-fix comments that use no prefix or use a weaker prefix instead of `Blocker:`.

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Avoid multiple writes without a transaction
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: Multiple `update!`/write operations that belong together must be wrapped in a transaction.
HOW: In added Ruby code, flag sequences of two or more writes (`update!`, `save!`, `create!`, etc.) performed without an enclosing transaction block.

2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.title: Do not short-circuit side effects in loops
2b939180-2cc8-4cd5-906a-15e4afb873a5.spec:
WHAT: Side-effecting calls inside loops must not be guarded by `||=` or similar short-circuit patterns that can skip execution.
HOW: In added loop code, flag `||=` or equivalent short-circuiting around a method call with side effects.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Use a private params method per action
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Each controller action must use its own private `*_params` method for permitted parameters.
HOW: In added controller lines, flag any action that directly consumes `params` or lacks a corresponding private `*_params` method for that action.

examples.snippet:
def create
  User.create(user_params)
end
private
def user_params
  params.require(:user).permit(:name)
end

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Never pass raw params to a model
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Controllers must not pass unpermitted raw `params` directly into model creation or update calls.
HOW: Flag added lines where `params` (or `params[...]` without strong-params filtering) is passed into `new`, `create`, `update`, `assign_attributes`, or similar model APIs.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Keep business logic out of controllers
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Controller actions must not contain business logic beyond simple CRUD and rendering/orchestration.
HOW: Flag added controller code that performs domain decisions, calculations, branching workflows, or other nontrivial logic instead of delegating to a service/interactor.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Delegate search/filter/pagination to existing abstractions
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Controllers must not implement search, filter, or pagination logic inline when an existing abstraction should be extended.
HOW: Flag added controller code that builds query logic for searching/filtering/paginating records instead of calling a service, scope, or other existing abstraction.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Do not use raw SQL in controllers
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Controllers must not contain raw SQL queries.
HOW: Flag added controller lines using `find_by_sql`, `connection.execute`, SQL strings in `where`, or other explicit SQL fragments instead of ActiveRecord scopes.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Sanitize user-controlled content before output or save
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: User input must be sanitized before persisting or rendering when the controller handles it directly.
HOW: Flag added controller lines that store or render user-provided content without `sanitize`, `strip_tags`, or equivalent Rails sanitization helpers.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Use t() for flash and copy text
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Flash messages, error responses, and redirect copy must use i18n translations via `t()`.
HOW: Flag added controller lines that hardcode user-facing text in `flash`, `render`, `redirect_to`, or similar response copy.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Authorize with CanCanCan early
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Controllers must use CanCanCan authorization with `authorize! :action, resource` early in actions.
HOW: Flag added controller actions that omit `authorize!` or replace it with hand-rolled role checks like `current_user.admin?`.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Do not use hand-rolled role checks
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Authorization must not be implemented with custom role/permission conditionals in controllers.
HOW: Flag added controller lines checking roles or permissions manually instead of calling `authorize!`.

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Use the correct framework for the endpoint consumer
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: New endpoints must be placed in the framework/location that matches the consumer type.
HOW: Flag added controller code that puts a browser HTML/session flow in a Grape API path, or a JSON API contract in a plain controller path, contrary to the routing/location table.

examples.snippet:
# app/controllers/api/v3/orders.rb
class Orders < Grape::API
  get { erb :index }
end

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Use snake_case Grape params
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: Grape parameter declarations must use snake_case names.
HOW: Flag added Grape `requires`/`optional` declarations written in camelCase or other non-snake_case forms.

examples.snippet:
params do
  requires :patientId, type: Integer
end

params do
  requires :patient_id, type: Integer
end

6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.title: Keep API changes additive
6ab8a71b-a710-4034-b315-1faafd8e7dbd.spec:
WHAT: API changes must add fields without removing or replacing existing released fields.
HOW: Flag added API controller/serializer changes that delete an existing response field or rename it in place instead of leaving the old field and adding a new one.

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Default new endpoints to v3
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: A newly added AcmeApp API endpoint must be placed under v3 by default, not v2 or v4.
HOW: In added route/controller lines, flag any new endpoint defined in a v2 namespace or in a v4 namespace when the diff does not indicate it is part of the dynamic server-side program-session redesign.

examples.snippet:
namespace :v2 do
  get '/reports' do end
end

namespace :v3 do
  get '/reports' do end
end

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Use v4 only for program-session redesign endpoints
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: An endpoint may be added to v4 only if it is part of the dynamic server-side program-session redesign.
HOW: In added lines, flag any new v4 endpoint whose path/resource is unrelated to the program-session redesign.

examples.snippet:
namespace :v4 do
  get '/exercises' do end
end

namespace :v4 do
  get '/program-sessions' do end
end

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Do not add new endpoints to v2
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: New endpoints must not be introduced in v2.
HOW: In added route definitions, flag any newly added endpoint under a v2 API namespace.

examples.snippet:
namespace :v2 do
  post '/items' do end
end

namespace :v3 do
  post '/items' do end
end

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Wrap deprecated endpoints with deprecated_endpoint
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: A deprecated endpoint must use the deprecated_endpoint helper around the implementation.
HOW: In added endpoint code, flag a deprecation path that returns data directly without a deprecated_endpoint(...) block.

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Use a stable deprecation slug
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: The deprecated_endpoint identifier must be a stable slug and must not be changed arbitrarily.
HOW: In added lines, flag deprecation calls that use a generic, ad hoc, or renamed string instead of a stable resource/version slug.

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Pass per-endpoint context to deprecated_endpoint
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: deprecated_endpoint should include a context: hash with per-endpoint context data when logging.
HOW: In added deprecation calls, flag uses of deprecated_endpoint(...) that omit the context: argument entirely.

detector.reason: Matches calls to deprecated_endpoint whose argument list does not contain a context: keyword.

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Do not log sensitive values in deprecation context
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: Context passed to deprecated_endpoint must not include sensitive values such as tokens or passwords.
HOW: In added context hashes, flag keys or values that clearly expose secrets (for example token, password, secret).

detector.reason: Added deprecated_endpoint context hashes that mention obvious secret-related keys can be detected on a single line with high precision.

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Use opaque pageToken pagination for new endpoints
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: New pagination must use pageToken as an opaque client echo token, not page/offset/cursor params exposed directly.
HOW: In added endpoint code, flag request/response pagination that introduces page, offset, or cursor parameters instead of pageToken/nextPageToken/prevPageToken.

examples.snippet:
params do
  optional :page, type: Integer
end

params do
  optional :pageToken, type: String
end

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Encode and decode pagination tokens with PageToken service
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: Pagination tokens must be produced and parsed with Pagination::PageToken.encode/decode.
HOW: In added pagination code, flag manual token construction/parsing or use of other helpers instead of Pagination::PageToken.encode(...) / decode(...).

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Carry per_page inside the pagination token
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: The pagination token must include per_page as the source of truth.
HOW: In added token-building code, flag tokens encoded without per_page or code that relies on request perPage after the first request instead of the token.

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Default perPage to 20 and cap at 100
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: New endpoints must default perPage to 20 and enforce a maximum of 100.
HOW: In added pagination parameter handling, flag defaults other than 20 or caps higher than 100, or missing DEFAULT_PER_PAGE / MAX_PER_PAGE-style limits.

3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.title: Return meta with nextPageToken, prevPageToken, and total
3fc02b58-9060-4b2f-a00f-febd52a83300.spec:
WHAT: Paginated responses must include a meta object containing nextPageToken, prevPageToken, and total.
HOW: In added response-building code, flag pagination responses that omit meta or omit any of those three fields.

examples.snippet: render json: { templates: templates, meta: { nextPageToken: nil, prevPageToken: nil, total: 0 } }

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Namespace each domain under its noun
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: A new domain organizer module must be named after the domain noun and live under that namespace.
HOW: In added lines, flag any top-level domain organizer constant that is not nested under a domain noun module (for example, defining `module Billing` is compliant, while `module Payments` for a Billing domain or a non-namespaced domain module is not).

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Put new multi-step logic in a service
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: New multi-step logic must be implemented in `app/services/`.
HOW: In added lines, flag a new organizer/interactor-style class or module containing multi-step orchestration logic when it is placed outside `app/services/`.

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Do not add new interactors
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: New code must not introduce a new interactor.
HOW: In added lines, flag `include Interactor`, `delegate ... to: :context`, or `context.fail!` in newly added code, since those patterns indicate an interactor.

detector.reason: The rule is directly expressible as a single-line pattern over added code lines matching the three listed interactor indicators.

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Keep existing interactors unchanged except in place
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: Legacy interactor code may only be modified in existing domains, not introduced as a new pattern.
HOW: In added lines, flag any newly added interactor-specific behavior in a domain organizer that was not already an existing interactor.

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Value objects must be plain Ruby
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: A value object must be plain Ruby, not an ActiveRecord model or framework-backed class.
HOW: In added lines, flag value-object files that inherit from framework base classes or declare persistence behavior instead of being plain Ruby objects.

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Provide a .for(record) constructor on value objects
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: A value object must expose a `.for(record)` constructor.
HOW: In added lines, flag value-object classes that do not define a `.for(...)` class method.

examples.snippet:
class Billing::Duration
  def self.build(record)
  end
end

class Billing::Duration
  def self.for(record)
  end
end

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Memoize collaborators inside value objects
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: A value object must memoize its collaborators.
HOW: In added lines, flag collaborator accessors that instantiate or fetch dependencies without memoization (for example, missing `@_... ||=`).

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Use query methods on value objects
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: A value object must expose query methods.
HOW: In added lines, flag value-object methods that are not predicate/query-style accessors or that mutate state instead of answering a question.

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Use I18n.t for user-facing strings
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: Any user-facing string must come from `I18n.t`.
HOW: In added lines, flag hard-coded literal strings that will be shown to users instead of being wrapped in `I18n.t(...)`.

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Capture swallowed exceptions with Sentry
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: If code swallows an error instead of re-raising it, it must report the exception to Sentry.
HOW: In added lines, flag `rescue` blocks that do not re-raise and also do not call `Sentry.capture_exception(...)`.

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Match file names to constant paths
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: Files must be snake_case and mirror the constant path.
HOW: In added lines, flag new files or class/module declarations whose filename casing or path does not correspond to the constant name.

9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.title: Place nested concerns in subdirectories with nested modules
9b25456c-fe15-41a2-84fc-f27ad4464b80.spec:
WHAT: Nested concerns must live in subdirectories and use matching nested module nesting.
HOW: In added lines, flag nested constants defined flatly in one file when the constant path implies a deeper namespace.

examples.snippet:
module APIEvents
  class LogNewClientCreatedEvent
  end
end

module APIEvents
  module Interactors
    class LogNewClientCreatedEvent
    end
  end
end

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Do not add new interactor classes
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: A diff must not introduce a new interactor in `app/interactors/`.
HOW: Flag added files or added class definitions under `app/interactors/` that define a new workflow object instead of modifying an existing one.

examples.snippet:
# app/interactors/create_order.rb
class CreateOrder
  include Interactor
end

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Use Interactor in interactor classes
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: An interactor class must include the `Interactor` module.
HOW: Flag added interactor class definitions that do not contain `include Interactor`.

examples.snippet:
class CreatePatientTransfer
  def call
  end
end

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Define a call instance method
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: An interactor must define an instance method named `call`.
HOW: Flag added interactor classes that lack `def call` in the class body.

examples.snippet:
class CreatePatientTransfer
  include Interactor
  def perform
  end
end

class CreatePatientTransfer
  include Interactor
  def call
  end
end

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Write outputs onto context
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: An interactor must assign result data onto `context`.
HOW: Flag added `call` methods in interactors that compute values but do not write them to `context` (for example, no `context.foo = ...` assignment).

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Use context.fail! for expected domain failures
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: Expected domain failures in an interactor must use `context.fail!`.
HOW: Flag added interactor code that handles a business-rule failure with `raise` or silent return instead of `context.fail!`.

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Attach failure data through context.fail!
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: When failing an interactor with an error message or payload, it must be passed to `context.fail!`.
HOW: Flag added failure paths that set an error variable separately or raise, instead of calling `context.fail!(error: ...)` (or equivalent payload arguments).

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Use raise only for unexpected failures
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: Interactors must not use `raise` for expected business-rule failures.
HOW: Flag added `raise` statements in interactor business logic when the failure is a normal domain outcome rather than an unexpected exception.

examples.snippet:
def call
  raise 'out of stock'
end

def call
  context.fail!(error: 'out of stock')
end

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Callers must check success? on returned context
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: Code calling an interactor must inspect `.success?` on the returned context before using its outputs.
HOW: Flag added caller code that uses `InteractorClass.call(...)` results directly without a `.success?` check.

examples.snippet:
result = CreatePatientTransfer.call(...)
render json: result.transfer if result.success?

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Read interactor outputs from the returned context
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: Callers must read outputs from the returned `Interactor::Context` object.
HOW: Flag added caller code that expects a plain return value instead of accessing attributes on the result context.

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Prefer services for new multi-step logic
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: New multi-step business workflows must go in `app/services/`, not in interactors.
HOW: Flag added code that introduces a new multi-step workflow under `app/interactors/` instead of `app/services/`.

examples.snippet:
# app/interactors/ship_order.rb
class ShipOrder
  include Interactor
end

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Do not use metaprogramming in interactors
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: Interactors must not use metaprogramming.
HOW: Flag added interactor code that defines behavior dynamically (for example, `define_method`, `send`, `class_eval`, or similar dynamic dispatch/metaprogramming patterns).

detector.reason: These are direct metaprogramming/dynamic-dispatch calls that can be detected on a single added line with high precision.

e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.title: Do not add mixins or concerns to interactors
e19949ed-49a1-4912-b1ab-dbde01a96a95.spec:
WHAT: Interactors must not use concerns or mixins.
HOW: Flag added `include`/`extend` of application mixins or concerns in interactor classes, other than `include Interactor`.

examples.snippet:
class CreateOrder
  include Interactor
  include Auditable
end

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Inherit from AppMailer
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: A mailer class must inherit from AppMailer instead of ActionMailer::Base.
HOW: In added lines, flag any class definition like `class X < ActionMailer::Base` or any mailer not extending `AppMailer`.

detector.reason: Direct inheritance from ActionMailer::Base is a single-line syntactic pattern that can be detected reliably on added lines.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Use deliver_later for async mail
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Asynchronous email delivery must use `deliver_later`.
HOW: In added lines, flag mail-sending code that calls `deliver_now` in a job/async context or otherwise sends immediately where async delivery is intended.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Use deliver_now for transactional mail
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Transactional emails must be sent with `deliver_now`.
HOW: In added lines, flag transactional mail code that uses `deliver_later` instead of immediate delivery.

detector.reason: Matches added lines that call deliver_later on mailers, which is the stated violation.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Wrap mail rendering in with_locale(user)
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: The mailer action must wrap the mail rendering call in `with_locale(user)` so both subject and body render in the recipient's locale.
HOW: In added lines, flag actions that call `mail(...)` without being inside a `with_locale(user) { ... }` block.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Use translated email subject keys
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Email subjects must use `t("emails.<domain>.<action>.subject", ...)`.
HOW: In added lines, flag any `subject:` value that is a hardcoded string or uses a non-`emails.*.subject` translation key.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Place mailer views in the mailer action path
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Mailer views must be colocated under `app/views/<mailer>/<action>.{html,text}.erb`.
HOW: In added lines, flag view files added outside that path or with a filename that does not match the mailer action name.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Match action name to view filename
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: The mailer method name must match the view filename.
HOW: In added lines, flag a mailer action whose name differs from the corresponding template basename it renders.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Use multipart_mail for HTML and text
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Mailers that render both HTML and text must use `multipart_mail`.
HOW: In added lines, flag actions that call `mail(...)` when the mailer is intended to render both `.html.erb` and `.text.erb` templates.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Attach files via attachments hash
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Attachments must be added with `attachments["program.pdf"] = file.read`.
HOW: In added lines, flag attachment code that uses a different API or does not assign the file contents through `attachments[...] = ...`.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Use branding helper for prefixes and titles
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Branding-related mailer content must come from `AcmeApp::Branding::App.determine(provider)`.
HOW: In added lines, flag code that hardcodes subject prefixes, logos, or app titles instead of calling the branding helper.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Use the required mailer naming pattern
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Mailer classes must follow the `{Domain}Mailer` naming pattern, including scoped names where appropriate.
HOW: In added lines, flag class names that do not end in `Mailer` or use an unsupported naming shape.

f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.title: Put mailer specs under spec/mailers
f656bd0b-fd3b-4c59-9065-fee49e52c382.spec:
WHAT: Mailer specs must live in `spec/mailers/…_spec.rb`.
HOW: In added lines, flag new or moved mailer spec files placed outside `spec/mailers/` or not ending in `_spec.rb`.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Keep business logic out of models
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Do not add business logic to an ActiveRecord model; models should contain only persistence-related concerns.
HOW: Flag added lines in a model that introduce domain decisions, orchestration, calculations, or other non-persistence behavior instead of validations/associations/basic data management.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Keep validations in the model
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Validations belong in the model and are allowed there.
HOW: Do not flag added validation declarations in a model as a violation of this rule.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Keep associations in the model
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Associations belong in the model and are allowed there.
HOW: Do not flag added association declarations in a model as a violation of this rule.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Use callbacks only for persistence maintenance
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Callbacks in models should be used only for necessary persistence-related maintenance, such as denormalized columns or input sanitization.
HOW: Flag added `before_save`, `after_commit`, or similar callbacks when they perform non-maintenance work or are added for reasons other than persistence-related upkeep.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Do not trigger external side effects from callbacks
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Model callbacks must not perform external side effects such as sending emails, enqueuing jobs, or making API calls.
HOW: Flag added callback methods or callback registrations in the model that call mailers, job enqueueing, HTTP clients, or other external integrations.

examples.snippet:
before_save :strip_name

def strip_name
  self.name = name.strip
end

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Prefer ActiveRecord queries over raw SQL
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Queries in models should use ActiveRecord query methods instead of raw SQL.
HOW: Flag added query code in the model that uses SQL strings directly when an equivalent `where`/`joins`/`merge`/scope form could be used.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Move AR-unfriendly queries out of the model
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: If a query is too awkward for ActiveRecord, it should live in `app/scopes/` as a named query object, not in the model.
HOW: Flag added complex query logic in a model when it is implemented as a custom SQL-heavy method instead of a scope/query object elsewhere.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Bind user input in queries
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Never interpolate user input directly into a query.
HOW: Flag added query strings in the model that embed variables via string interpolation or concatenation instead of bind variables or hash conditions.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Keep model files aligned with Zeitwerk constants
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Model file paths must match their constant paths according to Zeitwerk naming conventions.
HOW: Flag added model files or class/module declarations where the filesystem path and constant namespace do not correspond.

examples.snippet:
# app/models/branded_app/config.rb
module BrandedApp
  class Config < ApplicationRecord
  end
end

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Treat ignored_columns as temporary
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: `ignored_columns` should not remain in models permanently; remove it once the column is gone.
HOW: Flag added `ignored_columns` declarations in a model as a violation unless they are clearly temporary migration-era cleanup.

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Avoid introducing new STI hierarchies
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Do not add new Single Table Inheritance hierarchies in models; prefer composition.
HOW: Flag added `inheritance_column` usage or subclassing patterns that create a new STI tree in the model.

examples.snippet:
class Vehicle < ApplicationRecord
end

class Car < Vehicle
end

c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.title: Place model specs in the model spec path
c0a3d66d-0198-40ca-bcca-dd8be44bd1b7.spec:
WHAT: Tests for models must live in `spec/models/<model>_spec.rb`.
HOW: Flag added model tests placed outside the model spec path, such as service specs or other directories.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Keep policies as plain POROs
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: A policy object in app/policies/ must not inherit from a framework base class; it should be a plain Ruby object.
HOW: Flag added lines that define a policy class with `class ... < ...` (for example, inheriting from `ApplicationPolicy`, `Pundit::Policy`, or any other base class).

detector.reason: This directly matches added Ruby class definitions that inherit from a base class, which is the violation described.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Use domain objects in the constructor
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: A policy constructor must accept domain objects, not controller/request/auth framework objects.
HOW: Flag added `initialize` signatures in policy classes that take `user`, `current_user`, `params`, `request`, or similar framework-centric inputs instead of domain entities.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Expose predicates as public query methods
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: Policy public API methods must be predicate-style questions about the domain.
HOW: Flag added public methods in policy classes that are not predicates, especially mutators or command-style methods; predicate methods should read like `repeatable?`, `removable?`, etc.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Do not add Pundit Scope classes
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: Policies in app/policies/ must not define a Pundit-style `Scope` class.
HOW: Flag added nested `class Scope` definitions inside policy files.

examples.snippet:
class Scope
  def resolve
  end
end

detector.reason: Added nested Pundit scope classes are mechanically identifiable by a line that defines `class Scope`.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Do not use policy lookup mechanisms
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: Policy objects must be instantiated directly at the call site; there is no policy lookup/dispatch mechanism.
HOW: Flag added code that calls policy lookup helpers such as `policy(...)`, `policy_class`, or similar framework lookup APIs instead of `SomePolicy.new(...)`.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Surface reasons with ActiveModel::Errors when needed
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: If a policy needs to explain why a predicate is false, it must use `ActiveModel::Errors` to store the reason.
HOW: Flag added policy code that only returns a boolean while the surrounding implementation is clearly meant to expose failure reasons, or that omits `errors`/`ActiveModel::Errors` when adding reason-bearing logic.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Use feature flags with Flipper.enabled?
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: Feature-flagged policy rules must check flags with `Flipper.enabled?(:flag, user)`.
HOW: Flag added feature-flag checks that use another API or omit the user context when the rule is gated by a flag.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Use I18n.t for policy messages
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: Any user-facing policy message must be translated with `I18n.t`.
HOW: Flag added hard-coded message strings in policy code where a message is being produced instead of a translation lookup.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Name policies by concept and Policy suffix
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: Policy classes must be named `{Concept}Policy`, optionally namespaced by domain.
HOW: Flag added policy class names that do not end with `Policy` or that use a non-domain naming pattern.

4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.title: Test policies directly with predicate expectations
4d8df22e-8d7f-4e8c-b94c-e0c55c3e2cd9.spec:
WHAT: Policy specs must instantiate the policy directly and assert predicate behavior.
HOW: Flag added policy specs that use Pundit matchers or other framework-specific authorization matchers instead of `expect(policy).to be_...` style predicate assertions.

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Use a PORO for new non-v3 serializers
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: A newly added serializer outside the existing legacy/v3 areas must be a plain Ruby object, not a framework serializer class.
HOW: In added lines, flag a serializer class that inherits from `ActiveModel::Serializer` or includes `JSONAPI::Serializer` when the file is not under `api/v3/` and is not modifying an existing legacy serializer in place.

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Use initialize for record and optional scope
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: A PORO serializer must accept the record in `initialize`; it may also accept an optional `scope`.
HOW: In added lines, flag serializers that expose serialization via class methods only or that do not define `initialize` with the record argument.

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Expose as_json on PORO serializers
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: A PORO serializer must expose an `as_json` instance method.
HOW: In added lines, flag a PORO serializer that defines only other output methods (for example `call`, `to_h`, or class methods) and no `as_json` instance method.

examples.snippet:
class OrderSerializer
  def call
    { id: @order.id }
  end
end

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Use .call for props or aggregate objects
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: Props/aggregate serializer objects must use a `.call` class method that returns a frozen Hash.
HOW: In added lines, flag props/aggregate objects that serialize through `initialize`/`as_json` instead of a class `.call`, or that return a mutable hash from `.call`.

examples.snippet:
class OrderProps
  def self.call(order)
    { id: order.id }.freeze
  end
end

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Do not add new ActiveModel::Serializer classes
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: New serializers must not be introduced as `ActiveModel::Serializer` subclasses.
HOW: In added lines, flag any newly added class definition that inherits from `ActiveModel::Serializer`.

detector.reason: Matches added class definitions that directly inherit from ActiveModel::Serializer.

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Keep api/v3 serializers on JSONAPI::Serializer
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: Files under `api/v3/` must continue using the `jsonapi-serializer` pattern.
HOW: In added lines within `api/v3/`, flag serializers that do not extend `API::V3::BaseSerializer` or otherwise omit `include JSONAPI::Serializer`.

examples.snippet:
module API
  module V3
    class OrderSerializer < ApplicationSerializer
    end
  end
end

module API
  module V3
    class OrderSerializer < API::V3::BaseSerializer
    end
  end
end

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Name serializers with the Serializer suffix
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: Serializer classes must use the `{Concept}Serializer` naming convention.
HOW: In added lines, flag serializer class names that do not end with `Serializer` (except props/aggregate POROs, which may use `Props` or `Data`).

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Namespace serializers by audience or version
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: Serializer constants must be namespaced to match their audience/version path.
HOW: In added lines, flag serializer classes defined at the wrong namespace level for their area, such as a versioned serializer missing `API::V3` or an audience serializer missing its audience module.

examples.snippet:
module PatientAPI
  class ProtocolSerializer
  end
end

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Mirror the file path in the constant path
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: The file path must mirror the serializer constant path.
HOW: In added lines, flag a serializer whose module/class nesting does not correspond to the directory structure implied by the file being edited.

examples.snippet:
# app/serializers/patient_api/v3/protocol_serializer.rb
module PatientAPI
  module V3
    class ProtocolSerializer
    end
  end
end

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Format dates with I18n.l or explicit timezone conversion
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: Serializer date output must use `I18n.l` or explicit time-zone conversion.
HOW: In added lines, flag date formatting done with raw `strftime`, implicit local time, or other ad hoc formatting instead of `I18n.l` or explicit zone conversion.

a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.title: Test output shape and custom logic in serializer specs
a85eb1d2-c728-4db2-a050-d381b04b7a55.spec:
WHAT: Serializer specs must assert the output hash shape and custom logic, not the framework internals.
HOW: In added lines under `spec/serializers/`, flag tests that only check inheritance/framework behavior instead of asserting returned keys/values, nil handling, key casing, or date formatting.

examples.snippet:
it 'inherits from ActiveModel::Serializer' do
  expect(described_class < ActiveModel::Serializer).to be(true)
end

it 'formats the date' do
  expect(subject.as_json[:date]).to eq('2024-01-01')
end

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Keep ERB templates dumb
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: Do not add business or presentation logic to ERB templates in app/views/; ERB should only format and compose.
HOW: Flag added ERB lines that introduce conditionals, loops, assignments, calculations, or other non-trivial Ruby logic in the template.

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Put new UI in React, not new ERB
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: New UI or new features must be implemented in React under client/, not as a new server-rendered ERB view.
HOW: Flag added files or added template content in app/views/ that create a new screen/feature instead of a React component in client/.

examples.snippet:
// client/components/Reports.jsx export default function Reports() { return

Reports

; }

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Do not extend legacy app/assets/javascripts
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: New UI code must not be added to app/assets/javascripts/.
HOW: Flag added JavaScript in app/assets/javascripts/ or edits there that extend legacy frontend code.

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Use partials for reusable view components
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: Reusable view fragments should be extracted into partials instead of duplicated inline in ERB.
HOW: Flag added repeated component markup in app/views/ when the diff does not use render partial: or render collection: for the reusable piece.

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Use content_for for layout sections
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: Layout-specific sections must be defined with content_for and consumed with yield, not hardcoded in the body template.
HOW: Flag added ERB that tries to fill head/sidebar/footer-like layout slots without content_for do ... end.

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Move nontrivial ERB logic to helpers
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: If an ERB change adds more than a one-line conditional, the logic belongs in a helper, presenter, or view object instead of the template.
HOW: Flag added multi-line conditionals, nested branches, or complex expressions in app/views/ ERB.

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Review raw/html_safe/sanitize for XSS
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: Any user-provided string rendered with raw, html_safe, or sanitize must be explicitly reviewed for XSS risk.
HOW: Flag added ERB that pipes user-controlled data into raw(...), ...html_safe, or sanitize(...) instead of relying on escaped <%= %>.

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Use escaped output by default
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: User-facing output should use escaped ERB output, not unescaped HTML output.
HOW: Flag added <%-= ... %> style unescaped output or any added use of raw/html_safe when plain <%= %> would suffice.

detector.reason: Direct unescaped ERB output and raw/html_safe calls are mechanically detectable on a single added line.

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Localize user-facing strings with t()
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: Do not hardcode user-facing strings in ERB; use t() keys from config/locales/.
HOW: Flag added literal UI text in app/views/ ERB that is not wrapped in t(...).

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Use data-test-id, not data-testid
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: Elements intended for Capybara feature specs must use data-test-id, not data-testid.
HOW: Flag added HTML attributes named data-testid in app/views/ ERB or related rendered markup.

detector.reason: Matches added markup lines that use the forbidden data-testid attribute.

dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.title: Do not add standalone view specs
dd597f03-30b4-4ede-9fde-8d3255978e20.spec:
WHAT: Views should not be tested with standalone view specs.
HOW: Flag added spec/views/ files or view-spec style tests instead of feature specs or request specs.

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Use the bundle-specific named store hook
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: Do not use a generic `useStore`; use the bundle’s named Zustand hook for that bundle.
HOW: In added lines, flag imports or calls to `useStore` (or another non-bundle-specific hook) where the bundle should use `useAcmeStore`, `usePtDirectStore`, or `useSharedStore` instead.

examples.snippet:
import { useStore } from './store';
const count = useStore(s => s.count);

import { useAcmeStore } from './store';
const count = useAcmeStore(s => s.count);

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Create each slice in storeSlices/<sliceName>
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: A new slice must be created under `client/app/bundles/<bundle>/storeSlices/<sliceName>.{ts,js}`.
HOW: In added lines, flag slice files placed outside the bundle’s `storeSlices/` directory or not named as a slice module.

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Export the slice from storeSlices/index
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: Every added slice must be re-exported from `client/app/bundles/<bundle>/storeSlices/index.{ts,js}`.
HOW: In added lines, flag a new slice file that is not added to the `storeSlices/index` barrel export.

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Wire the slice into the bundle store
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: Every added slice must be included in `client/app/bundles/<bundle>/store.{ts,js}`.
HOW: In added lines, flag a slice export that is never imported/combined into the bundle store definition.

examples.snippet:
import { userSlice } from './storeSlices';
export const useAcmeStore = create((...a) => ({ ...userSlice(...a) }));

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Destructure only needed selectors from the store
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: Do not subscribe to the whole store; select only the needed fields/functions.
HOW: In added lines, flag `useXStore()` with no selector, or patterns that return the entire state object instead of destructuring specific selectors.

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Use immer for nested state updates
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: Nested Zustand state updates must use `immer` via `set(produce(draft => ...))`.
HOW: In added lines, flag manual deep-clone or spread-based nested updates inside `set(...)` instead of `produce(draft => ...)`.

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Keep slices small enough to split
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: A slice should not grow beyond roughly 200 lines; split oversized slices.
HOW: In added lines, flag a slice module that is clearly a large monolithic file (around 200+ lines) rather than a small focused slice.

examples.snippet:
// storeSlices/user.ts
export const userSlice = (set) => ({ /* many hundreds of lines */ });

// storeSlices/user.ts
export const userSlice = (set) => ({ user: null });

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Wrap Redux-backed class components in a functional wrapper
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: When migrating a Redux-backed class component, introduce a functional wrapper that reads from Zustand before the class is converted.
HOW: In added lines, flag direct class-component access to Zustand/Redux replacement state without an intermediate functional wrapper component.

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Pass Zustand state into the class as props
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: The wrapper must pass Zustand-derived state down to the class component as props.
HOW: In added lines, flag a wrapper that reads from the store but does not forward the selected state into the class component props.

c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.title: Do not add new Redux slices
c703433a-c5db-48d0-9c8f-52fdeb377304.spec:
WHAT: New state should be implemented in Zustand, not by adding Redux slices.
HOW: In added lines, flag creation of a new Redux slice/module (for example `createSlice(...)` or similar Redux slice definitions).

examples.snippet: export const useAcmeStore = create((set) => ({ user: null }));

detector.reason: Direct calls to Redux Toolkit's createSlice on added lines are a precise mechanical indicator of adding a new Redux slice.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Reject hardcoded user-facing strings
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: A user-facing string must not be hardcoded in Ruby, ERB, or React; it must come from i18n.
HOW: Flag added lines that introduce a string literal meant for users (for example in a controller, view, or component) instead of a translation lookup like `t(".key")` or the frontend i18n equivalent.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Use locale YAML files for translations
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: Every user-facing string must resolve to a translation key in `config/locales/`.
HOW: Flag added code that references a user-facing string without a corresponding locale-file key path, or adds text in code instead of adding it to `config/locales/*.yml`.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Prefer lazy lookup in controllers and views
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: In controllers and views, use lazy lookup (`t('.foo')`) when the string is scoped to the current action/template.
HOW: Flag added explicit non-lazy keys where a relative key should be used in the current controller/action/view context.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Use explicit shared keys for shared strings
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: Shared strings must use explicit dotted keys, not lazy lookup.
HOW: Flag added `t('.foo')` when the string is clearly shared across contexts and should live under a shared namespace like `shared.*`.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Keep translation key paths shallow
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: Translation key paths should not be deeply nested; avoid keys with 4 or more levels.
HOW: Flag added locale keys or lookup strings whose path depth is 4+ segments, such as `a.b.c.d`.

detector.reason: This flags single-line translation lookups with 4+ dot-separated path segments, which is the mechanically detectable part of the rule.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Add new keys to the relevant English locale file
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: When adding a translation, the key must be added to the relevant `*.en.yml` file under `config/locales/`.
HOW: Flag added code that references a new translation key without a matching addition in an English locale YAML file, or additions placed outside the relevant `*.en.yml`.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Auto-translate the required locales only
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: New translations must be added for `pl`, `es`, `ja`, `ko`, `fi`, and `ro` automatically.
HOW: Flag added locale entries that omit any of those required locales for a new key, or that add extra hand-written locales beyond those six.

examples.snippet: # missing pl/es/ja/ko/fi/ro entries for a new key
# new key present in en plus pl, es, ja, ko, fi, ro

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Do not add other locales by hand
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: Only the required translated locales should be added manually; other locales must be left missing for translator workflow.
HOW: Flag added locale entries for any non-required locale beyond `pl`, `es`, `ja`, `ko`, `fi`, and `ro`.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Run i18n-tasks normalize after adding keys
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: New translation keys must be normalized with `i18n-tasks normalize`.
HOW: Flag added locale YAML that is clearly unnormalized in structure/order/format relative to the existing locale conventions, indicating the normalize step was skipped.

examples.snippet:
en:
  users:
    z_key: Z
    a_key: A

en:
  users:
    a_key: A
    z_key: Z

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Preserve HTML markup in translations
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: Text enclosed in `< >` characters must not be modified during translation.
HOW: Flag added translation text that changes, removes, or reorders HTML tags or tag-like markup from the source string.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Keep interpolation placeholders intact
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: Interpolation placeholders like `%{variable}` must remain intact and correctly positioned.
HOW: Flag added translations that delete, rename, or move placeholders in a way that changes the sentence structure or removes the variable.

e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.title: Use Finnish product terminology correctly
e5eef331-6cb9-4ffa-b5ce-37dc3f1e96b0.spec:
WHAT: In Finnish translations, use `asiakas` for patient, `ohjelmaeditori` for program editor, and `frekvenssi` for frequency.
HOW: Flag added `fi` locale text that uses the forbidden alternatives `potilas`, `ohjelman luoja`, or `tiheys` in those meanings.

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Use concurrent index creation on large tables
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: A migration that adds an index must use `algorithm: :concurrently` instead of the default locking index creation.
HOW: In added migration lines, `add_index` appears without `algorithm: :concurrently`, or uses a non-concurrent algorithm.

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Disable DDL transaction for concurrent indexes
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: A migration that creates an index concurrently must include `disable_ddl_transaction!` at the top of the migration.
HOW: In added migration lines, `algorithm: :concurrently` is present but `disable_ddl_transaction!` is missing.

examples.snippet:
class AddIndex < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0]
  def change
    add_index :patients, :email, algorithm: :concurrently
  end
end

class AddIndex < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.0]
  disable_ddl_transaction!
  def change
    add_index :patients, :email, algorithm: :concurrently
  end
end

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Do not use change_column_null on existing large tables
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: Adding a NOT NULL constraint to an existing column must not be done with `change_column_null` in one migration.
HOW: In added migration lines, `change_column_null` is used to enforce non-nullability on an existing column.

examples.snippet:
def change
  # handled via staged migrations
end

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Move pure data backfills to a MaintenanceTask
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: A change that only backfills or transforms data, without altering schema, must be implemented as a MaintenanceTask instead of a migration.
HOW: In added migration lines, the diff contains data-update/backfill logic but no schema change, indicating a data-only migration.

examples.snippet:
class BackfillUsers < MaintenanceTask
  def process
    User.find_each { |u| u.update!(active: true) }
  end
end

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Avoid function defaults in add_column
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: `add_column` with a default must not use a function/expression default that rewrites the table.
HOW: In added migration lines, `add_column` includes a default like `-> { ... }`, `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`, or another callable/expression rather than a static literal.

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Add foreign keys without immediate validation
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: A foreign key addition must be created with `validate: false` first.
HOW: In added migration lines, `add_foreign_key` appears without `validate: false`.

detector.reason: Matches added lines that call add_foreign_key without validate: false on the same line.

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Validate foreign keys in a separate migration
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: Foreign keys added with `validate: false` must be validated later in a separate migration.
HOW: In added migration lines, the same migration both adds a foreign key and validates it, or validates immediately after adding it.

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Avoid renames on hot tables
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: Renaming a column on a hot table should not be done directly; use add/dual-write/backfill/switch/drop across deploys instead.
HOW: In added migration lines, `rename_column` is used for a table/column rename.

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Check views before dropping or renaming columns
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: Before dropping or renaming a column, any dependent DB view must be updated in its own staged migration.
HOW: In added migration lines, a column is dropped or renamed without any accompanying view update, suggesting the view was not handled.

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Measure query performance before and after index/query migrations
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: Migrations that add/change indexes or rewrite queries for performance must have EXPLAIN ANALYZE measurements captured before and after.
HOW: In added migration lines or PR-facing migration notes, the performance change is present but there is no evidence of before/after EXPLAIN ANALYZE numbers.

examples.snippet:
# EXPLAIN ANALYZE before: ...
# EXPLAIN ANALYZE after: ...

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Use representative data for performance measurements
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: Performance measurements for migrations must be run on representative data, not a tiny dev database.
HOW: In added migration notes or comments, the benchmark is described as using a small local/dev dataset instead of production replica or seeded staging snapshot.

examples.snippet: # tested on local dev DB with 10 rows

78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.title: Keep each migration to one logical change
78d8f7bc-89b9-4702-89bc-79f19cc39bd9.spec:
WHAT: A single migration should not bundle multiple unrelated schema changes.
HOW: In added migration lines, one migration contains both a column add and an index add as separate logical changes.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Do not add new Algolia-backed indexes
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: New search index code must not introduce or extend Algolia-backed indexing; Algolia is maintenance-only.
HOW: In added lines, flag any new Algolia index definition, registration, or write path (e.g. creating a new Algolia client/index for search data) instead of Typesense.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Define new schemas under lib/search/typesense/schemas
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: A newly added search index must define its collection schema in lib/search/typesense/schemas/.
HOW: In added lines, flag schema definitions placed outside lib/search/typesense/schemas/ for a new Typesense collection.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Register a sync job for the index
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: A newly added search index must include a sync job that emits data to the search backend.
HOW: In added lines, flag new index setup that lacks any job/worker/task registration for syncing records.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Use ClientWrapper.upsert or batched import for sync writes
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: Search sync jobs must emit through ClientWrapper.upsert or batched import, not another write API.
HOW: In added lines, flag sync code that writes search documents via a different method than ClientWrapper.upsert/import.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Add an integration spec against real Typesense
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: A newly added search index must have an integration spec that exercises the real Typesense container.
HOW: In added lines, flag new index work that only adds unit tests/mocks and no integration spec targeting real Typesense.

examples.snippet:
it "indexes product" do
  allow(ClientWrapper).to receive(:upsert)
end

it "indexes product", :integration do
  # hits real Typesense
end

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Do not mock Typesense in integration tests
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: Integration/request specs for search must use the real Typesense container, not mocks.
HOW: In added lines, flag specs that stub or fake Typesense/ClientWrapper in tests meant to cover the integration boundary.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Spy on ClientWrapper only for unit-level argument checks
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: Unit-level specs may spy on ClientWrapper only to assert call arguments, not to replace the integration boundary.
HOW: In added lines, flag unit tests that use ClientWrapper spies/mocks for anything beyond checking arguments passed to the wrapper.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Do not split one document's writes across unsafely concurrent jobs
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: If multiple background jobs write different subsets of the same document, that is a write race unless the writes are disjoint, serialized, or a true full-document upsert from one source of truth.
HOW: In added lines, flag new job code that writes partial fields for the same document from separate jobs without an explicit serialization/disjoint/full-document guarantee.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Treat ClientWrapper.upsert as full-document replace
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: Do not assume ClientWrapper.upsert merges fields; it replaces the entire document.
HOW: In added lines, flag code that uses upsert while only sending a partial subset of a document as if missing fields will be preserved.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Confirm env gate before assuming Typesense config is global
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: Typesense hybrid-search config must not be treated as global without checking its environment gate.
HOW: In added lines, flag config changes that apply the setting broadly without an explicit non-prod/env guard.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Do not tune hybrid distance threshold casually
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: Changing the hybrid-search distance threshold requires an A/B plan; do not adjust it casually.
HOW: In added lines, flag any direct change to the search config distance threshold value without accompanying experiment/A-B justification.

764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.title: Confirm embedding model for hybrid search
764188b9-ac20-4ce2-9526-714cb2996089.spec:
WHAT: If adding hybrid (vector) search, the embedding model must be explicitly confirmed.
HOW: In added lines, flag hybrid-search setup that omits any embedding model selection/confirmation.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Use unit specs for isolated class behavior
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: A spec for a single class's internal/public behavior must live in a unit-spec path, not in requests/features.
HOW: Flag added examples under `spec/features/` or `spec/requests/` when they are testing one class in isolation rather than HTTP/browser behavior.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Avoid let and let!
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Do not introduce `let` or `let!` in specs.
HOW: Flag added lines containing `let(` or `let!(` declarations.

detector.reason: Matches added spec lines that declare `let(` or `let!(` exactly as described.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Avoid large before blocks
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Do not add large setup `before` blocks that hide arrange steps.
HOW: Flag added `before do` / `before { ... }` blocks that perform setup instead of keeping setup inline in each example.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Use factory_bot for test setup
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Test data should be created with factory_bot helpers rather than ad hoc object construction for setup.
HOW: Flag added setup that instantiates domain records directly instead of using `build`, `build_stubbed`, or `create` from factories.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Prefer build over create when persistence is unnecessary
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: If persistence is not needed, do not use `create` in setup.
HOW: Flag added factory setup using `create(...)` where the example only needs an in-memory object and does not rely on DB persistence.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Spy on collaborator interactions with have_received
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Collaborator interactions should be asserted with spies and `have_received`, not by reaching into collaborator internals.
HOW: Flag added expectations that inspect collaborator behavior directly instead of stubbing/spying the collaborator and asserting `have_received(...)`.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Use one assertion per test when practical
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: A test should generally contain only one assertion unless multiple expectations describe the same behavior.
HOW: Flag added examples with multiple unrelated `expect` lines in one `it` block.

examples.snippet:
it do
  expect(user.active?).to be(true)
  expect(user.admin?).to be(false)
end

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Assert whole payloads with exact equality
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Specs that verify a serialized response or hash must compare the full expected body with exact equality.
HOW: Flag added assertions using partial matchers like `include`, `contain_exactly`, or single-key checks against a payload/hash.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Use descriptive it names
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Example descriptions must state the expected behavior, not the method name.
HOW: Flag added `it` strings that merely repeat a method or implementation term instead of describing an outcome.

examples.snippet:
it 'sends an invitation to the user' do
end

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Test behavior, not framework mechanics
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Do not assert that framework objects or framework internals work; assert the class's observable decisions instead.
HOW: Flag added expectations that verify framework mechanics such as memoization, constructor options, or private implementation details rather than outcomes.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Use literal fixtures, not loops or generators
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Test setup must use explicit fixture creation, not loops or helper logic that generates records.
HOW: Flag added setup that iterates to create records or hides record creation behind custom generator helpers.

23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.title: Freeze time in time-sensitive specs
23b28ae1-b640-4d3c-bb6f-5708dc528038.spec:
WHAT: Specs must not assert against live time.
HOW: Flag added expectations or setup that use `Time.now`, `Time.zone.now`, or `Date.today` without freezing/traveling time first.

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Wrap page/modal in a PageObject
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: A page or modal used by feature specs must be encapsulated in a PageObject under `spec/support/page_object/`, rather than interacting with raw Capybara directly.
HOW: Flag added test code that uses Capybara matchers/actions inline for page/modal behavior instead of calling methods on a PageObject class from `spec/support/page_object/`.

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Inherit PageObjects from PageObject::Base
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: Every PageObject class must inherit from `PageObject::Base`.
HOW: Flag added class definitions under `spec/support/page_object/` that do not use `class ... < PageObject::Base`.

examples.snippet:
module PageObject
  class NewPatientModal
  end
end

module PageObject
  class NewPatientModal < PageObject::Base
  end
end

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Name predicate methods has_*?
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: Predicate methods in PageObjects must be named with the `has_*?` convention.
HOW: Flag added predicate-like methods in page objects that use names such as `open?`, `visible?`, or `is_*?` instead of `has_*?`.

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Do not add waiting or retry logic in PageObjects
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: PageObjects must not implement explicit waiting/retry logic.
HOW: Flag added code in page objects that uses polling or retry constructs such as `sleep`, `wait_until`, `Timeout`, loops that repeatedly check a condition, or similar custom waiting around Capybara matchers.

examples.snippet:
def wait_for_modal
  sleep 1 until has_css?('#new_patient')
end

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Use a positive signal instead of polling for absence
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: If a flow has no positive signal to assert, the app should expose one; page objects should not poll for the absence of activity.
HOW: Flag added page-object code that waits for something to disappear or repeatedly checks that nothing happened after an action, such as `has_no_*?` used as the main synchronization point.

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Use data-test-id for new selectors
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: New selectors must use `data-test-id`.
HOW: Flag added selector strings that target `data-testid`, raw classes, generated IDs, or other non-`data-test-id` hooks for new test selectors.

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Do not select by raw class or generated ID
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: New selectors must not rely on raw CSS classes or generated IDs.
HOW: Flag added test code that uses selectors like `.btn-primary`, `#ember123`, or similar class/id hooks instead of stable test selectors.

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Do not put identifying data in data-test-id values
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: `data-test-id` values must not contain identifying data such as emails or names.
HOW: Flag added markup or test fixtures where the `data-test-id` attribute value interpolates or embeds user-specific text like an email address or person name.

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Assert text inside a stable test-id
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: When identifying a row or element by stable `data-test-id`, the specific record should be asserted via text inside that element, not by encoding the record into the test-id.
HOW: Flag added selectors that try to match a record using a dynamic `data-test-id` value instead of a stable one plus a text assertion.

671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.title: Keep feature specs to golden-path coverage
671eeb5f-c31e-4fac-aebe-0e7bb3011686.spec:
WHAT: Feature specs should cover the golden path only; edge cases belong in request specs or unit specs.
HOW: Flag added feature-spec examples that exercise error branches, boundary conditions, or negative cases instead of the main success flow.

examples.snippet:
it 'shows validation errors' do
  click_button 'Save'
end

it 'creates a patient' do
  click_button 'Save'
end

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Use request specs for new HTTP coverage
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: New API HTTP coverage must be written as a request spec, not a controller spec.
HOW: Flag added spec files that are controller specs or use controller-spec style for HTTP coverage instead of request-spec style.

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Place HTTP specs under spec/requests
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: New API HTTP coverage must live in spec/requests/.
HOW: Flag added HTTP coverage specs placed outside spec/requests/ when they are meant to test API requests.

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Dispatch request specs by URL path
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: Request specs must dispatch by URL path, not by controller action symbol.
HOW: Flag added request-spec code that uses action-symbol dispatch like get :show, post :create, etc.

detector.reason: Matches request-spec dispatch calls using an action symbol instead of a URL path.

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Stub only genuine external services
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: Tests must not stub real internal services like Postgres, Redis, or Typesense.
HOW: Flag added test code that replaces or mocks those internal containers/services instead of letting them run real.

examples.snippet:
# use the real Redis container
Redis.new

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Stub at the external boundary, not app wrappers
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: External integrations must be stubbed at the SDK client or HTTP transport boundary, not at internal app wrapper classes.
HOW: Flag added stubs/mocks on application wrapper classes around third-party services instead of the boundary client/request layer.

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Assert the boundary call was made
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: Tests must prove the external boundary interaction by asserting the boundary call was or was not made.
HOW: Flag added external-service tests that stub a boundary but do not assert with have_received or have_been_requested.

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Use have_received for stubbed SDK clients
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: When stubbing an AWS SDK client, assert the call with have_received on that stubbed client.
HOW: Flag added AWS SDK tests that omit have_received after spying on the client.

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Use WebMock for outbound HTTP APIs
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: Outbound third-party HTTP APIs must be stubbed with WebMock, not by stubbing Faraday or the app's HTTP client class.
HOW: Flag added tests that mock Faraday/new client objects for ordinary outbound HTTP instead of using stub_request.

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Assert outbound HTTP with have_been_requested
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: WebMock-stubbed outbound HTTP calls must be asserted with have_been_requested.
HOW: Flag added WebMock tests that define stub_request but never assert the request was made.

463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.title: Use real request bodies in fixtures
463415ba-0dea-42c2-9c01-0e561d7cd6a0.spec:
WHAT: Request bodies in specs must include every field the real client sends, not only the fields under assertion.
HOW: Flag added request fixtures or params hashes that are obviously partial/minimal when they represent a real client payload.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Do not commit decrypted encrypted credentials
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: `config/sops_credentials/` files and `*.enc.yml` must not be added in decrypted/plaintext form.
HOW: Flag added lines that contain decrypted secret values or plaintext credential content in files under `config/sops_credentials/` or matching `*.enc.yml`, instead of encrypted/sops-managed content.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Define Flipper flags in flipper_flags.yml first
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: A new Flipper flag must be declared in `flipper_flags.yml` before being enabled in the UI.
HOW: Flag added lines that introduce a flag name without the required `name`, `actor`, and `description` entry in `flipper_flags.yml`.

examples.snippet:
- name: new_checkout
  description: New checkout flow

- name: new_checkout
  actor: Global
  description: New checkout flow

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Sync Flipper features with the maintenance task
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Flipper feature definitions must be synced via `Maintenance::SyncFlipperFeatures` per region.
HOW: Flag added lines that change `flipper_flags.yml` but do not include the maintenance task invocation or equivalent sync step in the diff context.

examples.snippet:
- name: new_checkout
  actor: Global
  description: New checkout flow

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Do not use actor as an access gate
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: `actor:` in `flipper_flags.yml` is only a display label and must not be treated as a restriction on who can be enabled.
HOW: Flag added lines that use `actor:` to imply gating, authorization, or rollout constraints rather than a UI label.

examples.snippet:
actor: ProviderOnly
# only providers may enable this flag

actor: Provider
# display label shown in Flipper UI

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Treat Flipper flags as region-specific
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Flipper state for a flag is independent per region.
HOW: Flag added lines that assume enabling a flag in one region automatically enables it in another region, or that write a shared/global Flipper state for all regions.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Use registered staff-only groups for internal rollouts
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Staff-only rollouts must use the registered groups `internal_users` or `e2e`.
