HOW: Flag added lines that create a staff-only rollout using an unregistered group name instead of one of the allowed groups.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Load per-concern settings via config_for
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Per-concern files under `settings/` must be loaded with `config_for("settings/<name>")` in `config/application.rb`.
HOW: Flag added lines that read a settings file directly with YAML parsing or another loader instead of `config_for`.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Expose per-concern settings on Rails.application.config
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Per-concern settings loaded from `settings/` must be exposed as `Rails.application.config.<name>`.
HOW: Flag added lines that store the loaded settings somewhere else without assigning them onto `Rails.application.config.<name>`.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Nest region-scoped settings by env then region
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Region-scoped settings files must be structured as env → region.
HOW: Flag added lines in region-scoped YAML that place region keys at the top level instead of nesting them under environment keys.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Select region with COUNTRY fetch in region-scoped settings
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Boot must pick the region using `.fetch(ENV.fetch("COUNTRY").to_sym)`.
HOW: Flag added lines that select the region with a different env var access pattern, or that omit the `fetch(...).to_sym` lookup.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Keep secrets out of settings YAML literals
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Secrets in `settings/` YAML must come from sops credentials via ERB, not as inline literals.
HOW: Flag added lines in `settings/` YAML that contain a secret value directly instead of an ERB expression using `Rails.application.credentials.dig(...)`.

071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.title: Mount Grape APIs in routes.rb
071fa448-95b3-44c3-85c4-05256809fdf1.spec:
WHAT: Grape APIs must be mounted with `mount` in `routes.rb`.
HOW: Flag added lines that route a Grape API using `namespace` or `resources` instead of `mount API::... => "/..."`.

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Use a plain Ruby service class with `.call` entry point
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: A service object in `app/services/` must be a plain Ruby class that exposes a `.call` class method which instantiates the object and delegates to an instance `call`.
HOW: Flag added lines that define a service class inheriting from `ApplicationService`, mixing in a module/concern, or lacking a `.call` class method that does `new(...).call` with keyword args.

examples.snippet:
class Invite < ApplicationService
  def call; end
end

class Invite
  def self.call(patient:, inviter:)
    new(patient:, inviter:).call
  end
end

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Do not use metaprogramming for dispatch
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: Service code must not use metaprogramming such as `define_method`, dynamic `send`, or method names built from strings.
HOW: Flag added lines containing `define_method`, `send("#{...}` / `send(:"#{...}` patterns, or other dynamically constructed method names for dispatch.

examples.snippet:
case action
when :run then run
end

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Do not add concerns or mixins to services
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: Service objects must not use concerns or mixins; behavior should be composed via collaborators instead.
HOW: Flag added lines that `include`, `extend`, or otherwise mix in a module/concern inside a service class.

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Keep service methods private except `.call`
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: In a service object, only the `.call` class method should be public; instance helper methods must be private by default.
HOW: Flag added lines that define additional public instance methods in the service class without a `private` boundary before them.

examples.snippet:
class Invite
  def helper
  end
end

class Invite
  private
  def helper
  end
end

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Use ActiveRecord instead of raw SQL in services
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: Service code must use ActiveRecord query APIs, not inline raw SQL.
HOW: Flag added lines that call `find_by_sql`, `connection.execute`, or embed SQL strings directly in a service when the query is being built there.

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Move complex SQL into a query object
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: If a service needs a window function or other AR-unfriendly query, that SQL must not live inline in the service; it belongs in a query object under `app/scopes/` or `app/services/queries/`.
HOW: Flag added lines in a service that contain window-function SQL or similarly complex raw SQL fragments instead of delegating to a query object.

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Keep business logic out of models
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: Business logic that belongs to a service must not be implemented in `app/models/`.
HOW: Flag added lines in model files that introduce domain workflow/service behavior rather than persistence or associations.

examples.snippet:
class Patient < ApplicationRecord
  def invite
  end
end

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Translate user-facing strings with `t()`
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: Any user-facing string produced by a service must come from `t()` rather than being hard-coded.
HOW: Flag added lines in services that assign or return literal user-facing text like error messages or notification copy instead of calling `t(...)`.

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Name services under the domain noun namespace
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: Service classes must be namespaced under the domain noun and use a verb-first class name describing the action.
HOW: Flag added lines that define a top-level service class or place it under the wrong namespace instead of `Domain::Action` style naming.

examples.snippet:
module Patients
  class Invite
  end
end

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Return nested Success/Failure result structs
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: A service must return nested `Success`/`Failure` structs with a `.success?` predicate, not a shared base class or gem result object.
HOW: Flag added lines that define or return a different result type, or that omit nested `Success`/`Failure` structs with `success?`.

examples.snippet:
Success = Struct.new { def success? = true }
Failure = Struct.new { def success? = false }

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Use localized error arrays or symbol error codes
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: Service failures must use the prescribed error shape: controller-facing services return `errors:` with localized strings; service-to-service failures use `error:` or `error_code:` with a symbol code.
HOW: Flag added lines that return failures with the wrong error shape, such as raw exception objects or unlocalized strings where the contract requires localized `errors:`.

5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.title: Do not interpolate dynamic SQL fragments directly
5f670778-a492-440f-ac99-1f836e94716f.spec:
WHAT: SQL fragments must not interpolate values or column names directly into SQL strings.
HOW: Flag added lines that build SQL with `#{...}` inside a string for values, columns, or ordering instead of using `sanitize_sql_array` or `Arel.sql` with bind variables.
